Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 14  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer consistently retrieved and reported conflicting information regarding the cause of death, focusing on specific leukemia types without resolving the ambiguity from the sources that mentioned leukemia generally. While some sources indicated acute myeloid leukemia (AML), the focus on verifying the specific subtype (AML vs ALL) was not adequately addressed, and reliable sources that uniformly listed just "leukemia" as the cause were overlooked. This compounded the error by reinforcing potentially incorrect specifics rather than confirming the generalized but accurate cause of death as "leukemia." The mistakes lay in repeated cycles of querying similar terms without synthesizing the results pattern or solidifying what the authoritative sources collectively yielded (leukemia).
